title: PREVIEW_MODE env leakage silently turns the broadcast entry into a no-op that still patches mainnet-addresses.ts (zero-tx 'broadcast' exits 0, so the && chain runs the patcher)
description: Mode selection is an environment variable, not a CLI fact: if PREVIEW_MODE=true is still exported in the operator's shell (plausible — the runbook has the operator run the *-preview entries, and an export PREVIEW_MODE=true while iterating leaks into the broadcast invocation), `npm run migrate:ys-swap-reset` runs forge with --broadcast but the script takes the vm.startPrank branch, records ZERO broadcastable transactions, and — empirically verified on the fork — forge prints only 'Warning: No transactions to broadcast' and EXITS 0. The && chain then runs patch-mainnet-addresses-ys-swap.js, which unconditionally rewrites YieldStrategyDola/YieldStrategyUSDC in server/deployments/mainnet-addresses.ts. Result: the address registry (consumed by the UI/API) claims the V2 strategies are live while on mainnet the pools are still Migrating with no strategies wired and migrator1 in place.
impact: Law-3 non-obvious owner footgun: off-chain deployment registry desyncs from mainnet with exit-code success, misleading the UI and the operator's runbook checkpointing. No funds at risk directly; the on-chain system is simply not migrated.

classification.assetImpact: No funds at risk. A leaked PREVIEW_MODE=true env turns the broadcast entry into a zero-tx no-op that exits 0, so the && chain still runs the patcher and rewrites mainnet-addresses.ts — the off-chain registry claims V2 strategies are live while mainnet is still Migrating with no strategies wired.
attackPath: 1. Operator has PREVIEW_MODE=true exported from running preview entries.
2. npm run migrate:ys-swap-reset runs forge --broadcast but the script takes the prank branch, records zero txs, prints a warning, exits 0.
3. patch-mainnet-addresses-ys-swap.js unconditionally rewrites the registry; UI/API desyncs from mainnet with exit-code success.
classification.likelihood: Plausible env leak, but no on-chain effect — the system simply is not migrated and an off-chain file lies.
classification.assumptions: Non-obvious env-mode-confusion footgun; one-word fix to pin PREVIEW_MODE=false in package.json.
classification.externalRequirements: A stale env export in the operator's shell.

evidence: Empirical probe (script taking the prank branch under --broadcast): forge exit code 0 with 'Warning: No transactions to broadcast'; patch script has no on-chain verification (trusts ys-swap-deployments.json only); ResetAndRewire.s.sol:174 envOr default false.
recommendation: Pin the env in package.json: `PREVIEW_MODE=false forge script …` (one-word fix), and/or derive mode from forge context (vm.isContext(ForgeContext.ScriptBroadcast)) rather than an env var. Additionally, have the patcher verify on-chain (eth_call: original.yieldStrategy(DOLA) == ysDolaV2) before rewriting the registry.
dedupNotes: Sole source: reset idx2. Distinct root cause (EnvFlagModeConfusion). Standalone Low.
sanitizationReason: New entry point migrate:ys-swap-reset. PREVIEW_MODE env leak turns broadcast into a no-op that still patches the off-chain registry (exit 0). Non-obvious env-mode-confusion footgun (Law-3 in-scope). Not KI. NEW.
severityJustification: Non-obvious env-mode-confusion footgun (Law-3 in-scope): a leaked env var silently turns the broadcast into a no-op that still patches the off-chain address registry with exit-code success, desyncing the UI/runbook checkpointing from mainnet. No funds at risk (the chain is simply not migrated), so Low with a one-word pin fix plus an on-chain verification in the patcher.
